title: Single-writer event log: append, canonical hash, redaction
description: Implement append(): RFC 8785 canonical JSON, SHA-256 chain, idempotency keys (a duplicate returns the original), actor stamped by the daemon (agents never write events), secret-shaped values redacted before write, and one writer enforced by an in-process queue plus FW_HOME/fwd.lock.
acceptance: Appending the same (type, idempotency_key) twice returns the original event and writes nothing
A payload containing an API-key-shaped string is redacted before write and the redaction is itself recorded
Two processes racing to write: the second gets a typed LOCKED error and no event is lost or duplicated
